gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-noto-sans-tai-le: Chunky, bent-straw letters with no thick-thin shifts at all. And Noto Sans Tai Le, a plain sans, leaves its strokes open and tapering, so the heavy heading has something lighter to lean on.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-noto-sans-tai-tha: Plakkaat looks like glass tubing bent into letters, heavy and uniform from top to bottom. But Noto Sans Tai Tham does the quieter job, its sans-serif lowercase crowding the capital line with the inside of each c easy to see.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-noto-sans-tai-vie: Round bowls and joins as thick as the strokes themselves give Plakkaat its solid, closed-up look. Noto Sans Tai Viet sits beside it open and light.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-noto-sans-takri: Plakkaat's round bowls never swell or taper anywhere, so every curve reads as one smooth, heavy loop. Noto Sans Takri, a sans-serif with a high-waisted lowercase and generously unclosed curves, gives that weight room to breathe.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-noto-sans-tamil: Modern and bold at once, Plakkaat makes every diagonal as stout as every upright, closed tight. Noto Sans Tamil, a sans-serif, looks magnified and open.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-noto-sans-tamil-s: Noto Sans Tamil Supplement has round forms like open parentheses. Over a longer passage that stocky middle band keeps the lines clean and contemporary, while Plakkaat's closed, uniformly thick strokes stay out of the way up top.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-noto-sans-tangsa: Rope-thick curves, heavy and bold, ring each Plakkaat letter. Noto Sans Tangsa, a plain sans, counters with wide, inviting openings and short ascender stems that lighten the page below.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-noto-sans-tc: Noto Sans TC reads neutral and approachable, with large open counters in a, e and s and curves that flare outward. Plakkaat's fixed-width stencil-brush line sits above it, closed and heavy.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-noto-sans-telugu: Professional in manner, Noto Sans Telugu is a plain sans with a high-set midline. Its counters stay connected to the outside, so a longer stretch feels open and unhurried beneath Plakkaat's closed, heavy letters.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-noto-sans-thaana: Noto Sans Thaana reads wide and approachable, with big open lowercase forms. Plakkaat traces its heavy letters as if with one marker, and the sans follows with wide channels leading into each counter.
